## Projection Room

The Windows installer opens on a warm projector beam. The artwork stays steady while the progress bar follows actual file extraction. Options, installation details and native high-contrast controls are available.

Workbench now shares one bundled Chromium installation across browser tasks, graphics and project previews. Setup includes the WebView2 bootstrapper for PCs that need the runtime. The initial runtime and studio model downloads need an internet connection.

The built-in browser opens Google on its first empty session and keeps existing tabs. The [showcase](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench-downloads#one-prompt-one-finished-music-video) shows the one-prompt music-video workflow, the one-minute rock performance, five studio screenshots and local render measurements.

Source revision `804ab321da84a11644a0ad27b14575dfe27d9a66`.
### Clean installation results

Two fresh Windows x64 runners installed the public package, opened the desktop app and rendered a page offline in its bundled browser. Windows Server 2025 completed the interactive welcome, progress and finish screens in 22.1 seconds. Windows Server 2022 completed passive setup in 36.6 seconds. These timings exclude download and model setup.

The download fell from 281,749,404 to 207,236,916 bytes (26.4%). The fresh application footprint fell from 963,684,925 to 668,770,936 bytes before studio models. [Fresh Windows installation checks](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench-downloads/actions/runs/45371048250).
